name: Aqua Vitae
body:
Aura: strong necromancy; CL 12th; Slot: –; Price: 30,000 gp; Weight: 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This extremely rare holy water is also known as “Water of Life.” A dose of aqua vitae has all the effects of a heal spell when drunk by non-evil living creatures, and as a raise dead spell when poured into the mouth of a non-evil dead creature. No living creature can benefit from the effects of aqua vitae more than once in its lifetime. Repeated doses have no effect. If hurled as a grenade-like weapon upon undead of 8 HD or less, aqua vitae acts like a harm spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells heal, raise dead; Cost: 15,000 gp; Weight: —
